en: Sadr al-Din Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Shirazi
ar: صدر الدين محمد بن إبراهيم الشيرازي

description.tr: Müte'âliye Hikmet'in yaratıcısı; cevherde hareket kavramını önerdi || İslam felsefesindeki en iddialı sentez. || [Tarih notu] Etkisi ağırlıklı olarak Şiî gelenek içindedir.
description.en: Creator of Transcendent Philosophy; proposed substantial motion anticipating process philosophy || Most ambitious synthesis in Islamic philosophy — unifying Avicenna, Suhrawardi, and Ibn Arabi. || [Historiographical note] His influence is primarily within the Shi'i intellectual tradition.
description.ar: مبدع الحكمة المتعالية ونظرية الحركة الجوهرية || أكبر تركيب في الفلسفة الإسلامية
